I will stay close to what has worked for me here in Mwanza, because this plot is small and I cannot risk spending much cash at my age. I own this land, so I will put manure if I can collect enough, but I will not buy much chemical fertilizer because one bag is expensive and many people around me manage these mixed plots without it. I will keep using local seed from what I know, I will not irrigate, and I will rely mostly on family work with just a few paid days if digging or weeding becomes too heavy.
